mapper.insert: insert into explore_bundle_order (registration_id, holder_member_id, topic_id, activity_id, product_version, quota_version, policy_version, contract_version, settlement_rule_version, snapshot_json, paid_amount, valid_from, valid_to, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, create_time) values (#{registrationId}, #{holderMemberId}, #{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{productVersion}, #{quotaVersion}, #{policyVersion}, #{contractVersion}, #{settlementRuleVersion}, #{snapshotJson}, #{paidAmount}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, registration_id, holder_member_id, topic_id, activity_id, product_version, quota_version, policy_version, contract_version, settlement_rule_version, snapshot_json, paid_amount, valid_from, valid_to, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, create_time from explore_bundle_order where registration_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.insert: insert into explore_bundle_grant (bundle_order_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, topic_id, chapter_id, grant_no, grant_type, source_grant_id, units_total, valid_from, valid_to, create_time) values (#{bundleOrderId}, #{registrationId}, #{holderMemberId}, #{topicId}, #{chapterId}, #{grantNo}, #{grantType}, #{sourceGrantId}, #{unitsTotal}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, bundle_order_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, topic_id, chapter_id, grant_no, grant_type, source_grant_id, units_total, valid_from, valid_to, create_time from explore_bundle_grant where registration_id = #{registrationId} order by chapter_id asc, grant_no asc
mapper.insert: insert into explore_bundle_unit (grant_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, chapter_id, unit_seq, unit_code, unit_value, status, version, create_time) values (#{grantId}, #{registrationId}, #{holderMemberId}, #{chapterId}, #{unitSeq}, #{unitCode}, #{unitValue}, 'AVAILABLE', 0, #{createTime})
mapper.sql: select u.id, u.grant_id, u.registration_id, u.holder_member_id, u.chapter_id, u.unit_seq, u.unit_code, u.unit_value, u.status, u.redemption_id, u.reservation_id, u.status_reason, u.version, u.create_time, u.update_time, g.grant_no, g.valid_from, g.valid_to from explore_bundle_unit u join explore_bundle_grant g on g.id = u.grant_id
mapper.select: where u.registration_id = #{registrationId} order by u.chapter_id asc, g.grant_no asc, u.unit_seq asc
mapper.update: update explore_bundle_unit set status = 'REFUNDED', status_reason = 'REFUND', version = version + 1, update_time = now() where registration_id = #{registrationId} and status in ('AVAILABLE', 'RESERVED', 'HELD')
mapper.insert: insert into explore_bundle_reservation (unit_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, chapter_id, offer_id, merchant_id, start_at, status, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, version, create_time) values (#{unitId}, #{registrationId}, #{holderMemberId}, #{chapterId}, #{offerId}, #{merchantId}, #{startAt}, 'BOOKED', #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.sql: select id, unit_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, chapter_id, offer_id, merchant_id, start_at, status, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, closed_at, version, create_time, update_time from explore_bundle_reservation
mapper.select: where registration_id = #{registrationId} order by id asc
mapper.update: update explore_bundle_reservation set status = 'CANCELLED', closed_at = now(), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where registration_id = #{registrationId} and status = 'BOOKED'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into explore_bundle_waiver (member_id, waiver_month, reservation_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{waiverMonth}, #{reservationId}, now())

insert into explore_bundle_exit_case (unit_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, exited_offer_id, reservation_id, decision, target_offer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, create_time) values (#{unitId}, #{registrationId}, #{holderMemberId}, #{exitedOfferId}, #{reservationId}, #{decision}, #{targetOfferId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createTime})
mapper.sql: select id, unit_id, registration_id, holder_member_id, exited_offer_id, reservation_id, decision, target_offer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, create_time from explore_bundle_exit_case
mapper.select: where registration_id = #{registrationId} order by id asc
